title: Retry the payment webhook when the gateway times out (CU-86abc123)
description:
The gateway sometimes takes longer than our 10s timeout, and the webhook is dropped.

## What changes
- Retry up to 3 times with backoff: 1s, 4s, 16s
- Log every retry with the order id, so support can find it
- `PaymentWebhookHandler.handle_timeout_and_schedule_the_next_retry_attempt()` is new

Task: https://app.clickup.com/t/86abc123

| case | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| timeout once | dropped | retried, paid |
| timeout 4 times | dropped | failed, logged, alerted |

Parent: [Sentry → AI 分流與排查](https://app.clickup.com/t/9008039987/q12rs34tu5)

https://acme-shop.sentry.io/issues/4512345678/events/9f8e7d6c5b4a39281706f5e4d3c2b1a0/?project=4505

```
PAYMENT_RETRY_BACKOFF=1,4,16 PAYMENT_RETRY_MAX=3 PAYMENT_RETRY_LOG_LEVEL=warning python manage.py runworker payments
```
